scope: Fault-injection regression of production navigation, mission and report paths with synthetic frames and actuator boundary fixtures; not a browser, live model, or five-trial completion test.
checks: Navigation encode startup/execution failures preserve typed diagnostics, count zero transmissions/actions, and stop without another model call
Navigation post-transmission decode failure retains the acknowledged action and diagnostic, then stops with no resend
Unconfirmed sent command remains separate from acknowledged motion and is never resent
Auxiliary encode timeout ends the mission at its current phase instead of asking the model to retry
Auxiliary decode failure records one acknowledged motion and stops without another model call or actuation

Front engine invalidates readiness for typed terminal driver faults, retains handshake evidence, exports complete runtime diagnostics, and keeps event metadata compact; vision-only failures do not invalidate the driver
